title: Build a learning curve and read it
brief: Hold out one fixed validation set, train on growing prefixes of the rest, and turn the two curves into a verdict: underfit, overfit, or good.
hints: validation_split: order = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(n); the first int(round(val_fraction * n)) entries are the validation rows and the rest are the pool.

learning_curve calls validation_split once, then for each size trains on pool[:size], so every training set contains the one before it. Score the training error on pool[:size] and the validation error on val_idx.

diagnose_curve looks only at the last entry of each curve: gap = val[-1] - train[-1]. A gap above gap_threshold is 'overfit'; otherwise a validation error above high_threshold is 'underfit'; otherwise 'good'.
